orderedPublicImages.alt: AI-generated fictional Uruguay-inspired bay-lounge fashion scene. A braided woman in cobalt rests her head against a blonde companion in coral; a woman in a blue-and-white sun-motif mini reaches toward them, while a fourth in navy sits higher. Rainbow and coral boots, GRD lettering and star tattoos are visible. Distant fires, smoke and a mushroom-shaped cloud are imaginary background effects, not a real disaster or news photograph.

AI-generated Uruguay-inspired fashion editorial of four fictional adult women in a coastal window lounge, arranged at different seated and leaning heights around a warm handclasp. Their opaque mini outfits are sea blue, ivory with copper lines, green and silver with blue panels. Rainbow stockings, pale-blue boots, white platforms and bright sandals vary the styling. IA, agency, crescent and subtle RAZE marks are visible. Dunes, rocks and ocean outside are fictional scenery.

AI-generated fictional Bosnia and Herzegovina-inspired glass-lounge scene. Four adult women in forest green, sapphire and ivory, silver and green, and pearl with cobalt seams gather around a seated handclasp and shoulder touch. Rainbow knee-high hosiery, scorpion and crescent tattoos are visible. Beyond the windows are a green river, pale arches and distant fire with mushroom-shaped smoke. These are imaginary background effects, not a real disaster, conflict or news photograph.

AI-generated close portrait of four fictional adult women in a Bosnia and Herzegovina-inspired forest-window lounge. A braided woman in a structured pine-green sleeveless garment embraces a smiling blonde companion in blue and yellow. Behind them, two dark-haired companions wear ivory with cobalt seams and blue-yellow color blocking. Their faces sit at different heights; all garments are opaque and covered. A scorpion tattoo and IA upper-arm lettering are visible. Forested slopes are an imagined backdrop.
